tex_content.label: 4times
tex_content.html:
Let $(M,g)$ be Riemannian, let $B(p,2r)$ have compact closure, and let $f:B(p,2r)\times (-2r,0]\to \Ar $ be continuous and bounded with $f(p,0)>0$. There is $(q,t)$ in this cylinder such that, for $\alpha =f(p,0)/f(q,t)$,

  1. $f(q,t)\geq f(p,0)$;

  2. $d(p,q)\leq 2r(1-\alpha )$ and $t\geq -2r(1-\alpha )$;

  3. $f(q',t')<2f(q,t)$ on $B(q,\alpha r)\times (t-\alpha r,t]$.

Proof

\sketch Starting at $(p,0)$, whenever (3) fails choose a point in the indicated parabolic neighborhood where $f$ at least doubles. After $j$ steps the accumulated spatial and backward-time displacements are at most $r(1+2^{-1}+\cdots +2^{1-j})<2r$, whereas $f\geq 2^jf(p,0)$. Boundedness of $f$ forces termination, and the geometric sums give (1)–(3).

□

Corollary
[Time-independent point-picking]
